Gleuhr Guide — Accounts (draft)
 Oct 27, 2026  ·  @Aman
This is the draft of the Accounts module of the Gleuhr Guide, for your approval before it is
built into the app. It is for everyone who works the clinic Accounts panel: the clinic
accounts desk and the online accounts staff who work it. The panel is the same for both;
only Tally mapping shows just for a login that also holds the clinic accounts desk.
What is in it: 42 How do I…? cards, 15 rules, 10 lessons with 30 check questions, and 5
sign-off tasks.
How it was checked: every button name and step was read from the app as it is today
(27 Oct). Every refusal message is quoted from the server. Nothing comes from
memory or an old manual.
Screenshots: made-up data only. Five are placed. The others are shown as [Screenshot
to add …] lines until they are rendered.
Who signs off an accounts joiner: your sign-off lead (the accounts desk has no branch
manager).
How to review: comment on any line, or edit it directly. Anything you change becomes
the text staff see.
1 · Responsibilities
What this desk is for
The clinics collect money all day. Accounts makes sure that money is real, is invoiced and
is matched to the bank:
Remote instalments. A patient paid from home by UPI, and a counsellor recorded it. It
counts only once you check the proof against the bank and press Verified.
Invoices. Every payment collected on a clinic sale gets an invoice in Tally. Packages get
one invoice per payment. Consultations get one invoice per visit (from 20 Oct 2026).
Receipts. Every payment gets a clinic receipt number. From 21 Oct 2026, every bank
credit also gets a Tally receipt through Bank reconciliation.
Bank reconciliation. Each day's bank statements and card-machine files are uploaded
and matched to the CRM's payments, credit by credit. Then the day is locked.
Money on file. The Tokens page shows every token taken, what is left on it and where
it was spent.
Closing the books. Reconciliation is where you tick each invoice once you have seen
its money in the bank.

blocks.title: Page 3
blocks.text:
Your day, from opening to the lock
1 . Open the desk. It opens on To invoice. A red badge on any menu item means work is
waiting there.
2. Verification first. Clear the queue, oldest first. Each claim you decide is money that
reaches (or does not reach) a patient's package.
3. To invoice. Press Send for invoicing on each Pending payment. Check the Failed tab.
4. Bank reconciliation for yesterday. Statements come in between 11:30 and 12:30.
Upload them and the processor files. Then work every credit until the day can lock, and
Lock it.
5. Pending receipts. Press Mark as created on payments that need a clinic receipt
number.
6. Reconciliation. Tick Mark received on invoices whose money you have seen in the
bank.
7. Before you leave. Make sure nothing is stuck: no Failed request left unread, no day left
unlocked that could lock.
2 · Rules
These are the rules that bind your desk. The app enforces most of them. Know them
anyway, so a refusal never surprises you.
The rule Why
Never verify a claim you recorded yourself.
The screen and the server both refuse it.
One person never both records and
approves the same money.
Verify only the amount the proof and the
bank actually show. The amount you type
must equal the amount claimed.
Typing the amount is the whole check. A
guess posts money that may not exist.
One bank reference verifies once. The only
exception is one transfer that paid for
several patients: tick it as shared and give
the bank total.
The same screenshot must never pay two
packages.
Payment-link money never comes to you.
The gateway confirms it by itself.
Only money the CRM cannot confirm needs
a person.

blocks.title: Page 4
blocks.text:
The rule Why
One invoice per payment received. A
package paid in four instalments is invoiced
four times. A consultation is invoiced once
for its visit, however many ways it was paid
(from 20 Oct 2026).
The invoice follows the money that actually
landed.
Never retry a "No answer" before checking
Tally. If the invoice is there, record its
number instead.
"No answer" means the invoice may already
exist. A retry could make a duplicate.
A "Refused" request made nothing, so it is
safe to send again once the objection is
fixed.
Tally told us it did not take it.
You never edit a sale or a payment. The
money book is append-only. A wrong amount
is corrected by reception's amendment,
which the BM verifies.
Nothing is ever silently overwritten. Every
change leaves a record.
A clinic receipt number is given once and
cannot be undone.
A receipt number is a promise in the books.
A credit note number, once recorded,
cannot be changed.
The same reason. Check the number in Tally
before you save.
In Bank reconciliation, nothing goes to Tally
until the day is locked. After the lock,
receipts go out one by one.
A day is checked as a whole before any of it
reaches the books.
A locked day cannot change. Files cannot be
added, replaced or removed, and no credit
can be re-decided.
A locked day is a closed book.
A receipt Tally has accepted has no Undo
here. Cancel it in Tally.
The CRM never pretends to remove
something that is already in Tally.
A "No success code" receipt is never
resent by itself, and is withdrawn only after
you check Tally.
It may already be in Tally.
Online orders are invoiced in the online
CRM, never here. The Clinic pickup and
Rapido lists are for reading only.
Anything created there is invoiced there,
and anything created here is invoiced here.

blocks.text:
3 · Processes
My pages
The menu, top to bottom, with each page's job. How to use and Sign out are in the menu
under your name, top right. On a phone, the bottom bar reads Verify · Invoice · Receipts ·
Reconcile · More.
Remote payments
Verification: claims for money a patient paid from home, recorded by a counsellor, plus
booking deposits an agent captured directly. Each waits for you to press Verified or
Not verified.
Decided claims: the record of every claim already answered, by whom and when. It is
for reading only. It shows the newest 200.
Invoicing
To invoice: every collected payment with no invoice yet. The Automatic invoicing
switch on the right is Off and reads "Not available yet". It has three tabs:
Pending: press Send for invoicing.
Failed: requests Tally refused or did not answer.
Waiting: requests still on their way. It only appears while it holds something.
Invoiced: every payment Tally has taken, or that has a number recorded. It is a record
to search, not a worklist.
Manual invoices: payments the automation can never bill. You make the invoice in Tally
and type its number here.
Reversed: payments reversed after their invoice was already in Tally. You make the
credit note in Tally and record its number. It has two tabs, To do and Credit note
recorded.
Receipts
Pending receipts: every payment on a clinic sale with no clinic receipt number yet,
invoiced or not.
Receipts created: payments that have their clinic receipt number.
Bank reconciliation: the day page. Each bank credit is matched to CRM payments and
gets a Tally receipt. It opens on yesterday.
Unmatched: one day's leftovers on both sides. These are bank rows with no CRM
payment, and CRM payments with no bank credit.
Receipt sent: every Tally receipt made from Bank reconciliation, with Tally's success
code.

blocks.title: Page 6
blocks.text:
Receipts not invoiced: CRM payments that a Tally receipt covers but that have no
invoice yet.
Money on file
Tokens: every token. "T-" is a token taken by the counsellor at the clinic. "A-" is a token
taken by the appointment agent by payment link before the visit. The page shows what
is left on each token and where it was used. It only reads.
Closing the books
Reconciliation: every invoice this desk created. Pending receives is the worklist and
Done is the record. Mark received means you checked the money against the bank by
hand.
Configuration
Tally mapping: the name, HSN / SAC and tax % sent to Tally for each treatment. It
shows only on a login with the clinic accounts desk. The Sales Head edits the same
page.
WhatsApp receipts: every patient receipt the clinics issued, and whether it reached
the patient on WhatsApp.
The search box at the top searches the page you are on. On the invoicing and receipt
pages it searches: "patient, clinic, sale, payment, amount, our reference, Tally or receipt
number, phone, or the reason a row is held."
How do I…? · Remote payments
A1. How do I verify a remote UPI instalment?
When you need this: Verification has a badge. A counsellor recorded money a patient
sent from home.
Steps:
1 . Open Verification. Click the claim at the top (the oldest).
2. The proof is on the left. "What the claim says" is in the middle.
3. Check the bank for this Transaction / UTR and amount.
4. In Amount you can see on the proof, type the amount the proof and the bank show, in
whole rupees.
5. When it reads " ✓  Matches the amount claimed", press Verified.
6. Press Next claim →.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:

After you press it, the screen says "Verified — the money is posted" and "The
instalment is on the patient's ledger and the package balance has moved. The receipt
has been queued to WhatsApp."
"This is not the amount claimed. Verify only what the money actually was." Verified
stays off. If the money really was different, mark it Not verified with a note (see A2).
"No proof on file". The counsellor recorded it without a screenshot. Check the bank
against the reference and amount before you verify.
If the payment was more than the package still owed, the screen says the extra "is held
as store credit for the patient — it is not cash back".
"This claim has already been decided". Someone else decided it while you had it open.
Nothing was sent. Press Back to the queue.
Who to ask: the counsellor who recorded it (their name is under the title).
Search words: verify, verification, UPI, GPay, PhonePe, screenshot, remote payment, ghar
se payment, instalment, installment, UTR, proof check, claim.
Screenshot: [Screenshot to add: The verify workspace: the proof, what the claim says, and
Verify and decide]
A2. How do I mark a claim Not veriﬁed?
When you need this: the money is not in the bank, the amount is different, or the proof is
wrong.
Steps:
1 . Open the claim.
2. Under Note, write what you checked and why it is not verified. A note is required.
3. Press Not verified.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Recorded as not verified" and "No money was posted and the package balance is
untouched. The follow-up on this balance stays standing, so the system keeps
remembering it."
If Not verified is grey with "Note needed", you have not written the note.
For a booking deposit, the server also refuses without a note: "say why it is not verified
— the agent re-captures from this reason".
Who to ask: the counsellor (or, for a booking deposit, the agent) acts on your note.
Search words: reject, not verified, wrong amount, fake screenshot, payment nahi aaya,
mismatch, decline claim.
[Screenshot to add: Verification workspace, Not verified with a note typed]
Gleuhr Guide — Accounts (draft)
Page 7 of 41

blocks.title: Page 8
blocks.text:
A3. Why can't I verify this claim? It says "You recorded this"
When you need this: both buttons are grey and the caption reads "You recorded this".
Steps:
1 . Leave the claim. Someone else on the accounts desk must decide it.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "You recorded this claim yourself, so you cannot verify
it. Someone else on the accounts desk has to." The server says the same: "the person who
recorded a claim never verifies it".
Who to ask: another accounts colleague.
Search words: own claim, self verify, can't verify, buttons grey, maker checker.
[Screenshot to add: Verification workspace, "You recorded this" caption under both
buttons]
A4. One bank transfer paid for two patients. How do I verify both?
When you need this: a family member sent one UPI for two packages, so two claims carry
the same UTR.
Steps:
1 . Open the first claim and tick This one transfer paid for more than one patient.
2. In Bank total for this transfer, type the whole amount the bank shows for that one
transfer.
3. In the note, name the other patient(s) this transfer paid for.
4. Type this claim's amount and press Verified.
5. Repeat for the other claim, with the same bank total.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Transaction/UTR … was already verified as one shared transfer of ₹ … — this one says
₹ …. One transfer has one bank total". Type the same bank total each time.
"This transfer is ₹ … but the claims on it would add up to ₹ … …". The claims add up to
more than the bank received. Do not verify the extra one. Mark it Not verified with a
note.
Who to ask: the counsellors who recorded the claims.
Search words: shared transfer, same UTR, one payment two patients, family payment,
joint payment, duplicate reference.
[Screenshot to add: Verification workspace, shared-transfer tick on, bank total and note
fields showing]
Gleuhr Guide — Accounts (draft)

blocks.title: Page 9
blocks.text:
A5. The server says the reference is "already veriﬁed". What now?
When you need this: you press Verified and a red line appears.
Steps:
1 . Read the line. It names the claim that already used this reference.
2. If one transfer really paid for more than one patient, use A4.
3. If not, the same screenshot was recorded twice. Mark this claim Not verified and say
so in the note.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Transaction/UTR … is already verified on clinic installment claim #… — the same
reference can never verify twice"
"Transaction/UTR … is already booked on online order … — the same reference can
never be spent in both books"
Who to ask: the counsellor who recorded it.
Search words: duplicate UTR, same reference, already verified, double claim, repeat
screenshot.
[Screenshot to add: Verification workspace, red duplicate-reference refusal]
A6. How do I verify a booking deposit?
When you need this: the queue shows a row reading "Booking deposit" instead of a
package name.
Steps:
1 . Do the same as A1: check the proof, type the amount, then press Verified or Not
verified.
2. A Not verified booking deposit needs a note. The agent recaptures from it.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "this is not a direct advance to verify — a payment-link
advance verifies itself through the gateway". Link money never needs you.
Who to ask: the appointment agent who captured it.
Search words: booking deposit, advance, booking amount, agent advance, direct advance.
[Screenshot to add: Verification queue, a "Booking deposit" row]

How do I…? · Invoicing: sending and failures
B1. How do I send a payment for invoicing?
When you need this: every day. To invoice › Pending has a badge.
Steps:
1 . Open To invoice. The Pending tab is open.
2. Optional: click the row to open the payment panel and read "Lines that will go to Tally".
3. Press Send for invoicing on the row, once per payment.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Sent as CI-… — waiting on the billing tool." The row leaves Pending.
Most invoices never get a number back from Tally, and that is normal. The row moves to
Invoiced with "Sent to Tally".
If the button is grey with "Billing company not set", nothing can go to Tally until that
setting is set (see "If this happens…").
A red line under the row is the server's own reason. For example: "no Tally name is
mapped for … — map it on the Sales-Head Tally page before this invoice can be sent
…". See B9.
Who to ask: —
Search words: invoice, bill, Tally, send invoice, invoicing, bill banana, GST bill, pending
invoice.
Screenshot: [Screenshot to add: To invoice, Pending tab, each row with Send for invoicing]

B2. How do I ﬁnd one payment?
When you need this: someone gives you a name, an amount or a reference.
Steps:
1 . Type it in the search at the top. Search covers the patient, clinic, sale, payment,
amount, our reference, Tally or receipt number, phone, and the reason a row is held.
2. Or narrow the list with the filter row: Which book, All clinics, All sale types, Paid by,
Amount, Purchase date, Sort.
3. To filter on the day the money came in, open the date button and switch Dates on to
Payment date.
4. Click a column heading to sort by it.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Nothing matches these filters. Clear them to see all …"
A banner "This page is not showing the whole book". Narrow the dates.
Who to ask: —
Search words: search, find payment, filter, date filter, amount filter, dhundo, payment
kahan hai, sort.
[Screenshot to add: To invoice filter row with the Dates dialog open]
B3. How do I invoice consultation fees?
When you need this: consultation fees from 20 Oct 2026 onward.
Steps:
1 . Open To invoice. Set All sale types to Consultations to see only them.
2. A consultation row reads "Consultation #…" with "Visit #…" under it.
3. Press Send for invoicing, as for any payment.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
One invoice covers the whole consultation fee, however it was paid. For example, card
plus UPI is one invoice. A token or advance used toward the fee is folded into it.
A consultation appears only once it is fully paid.
On Tally it goes as one line: "Cosmetic Skin treatments and related services" (HSN
999722, GST 5%).
Fees before 20 Oct are not invoiced.
A fee moved into a package is invoiced with the package.
Who to ask: —

B4. A request says "Refused". What do I do?
When you need this: To invoice › Failed has a red count.
Steps:
1 . Open To invoice › Failed. Set Outcome to Refused if you want only those.
2. Click the row. The red line and "What the billing tool answered" show Tally's words.
3. Fix what Tally objected to, for example a Tally name or an HSN code (B9, B10).
4. Press Retry.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Attempt … queued — waiting on the billing tool."
The Refused note: "Nothing was invoiced. Fix what it objected to and send again — this
is the one case where sending again is safe, because the tool told us it made nothing."
"this request carries discounts the billing tool misreads (…) — Tally would book them
many times larger; raise this invoice by hand instead of retrying". Make it in Tally and
type the number into Add invoice number.
Who to ask: the Sales Head (Tally names) or an admin (product HSN / tax).
Search words: refused, failed, Tally error, retry, invoice failed, rejected by Tally, error aaya.
Screenshot: [Screenshot to add: To invoice, Failed tab]
B5. A request says "No answer". What do I do?
When you need this: a row on Failed reads No answer.
Steps:
1 . Do not press Retry yet. Open Tally and look for the invoice.
2. If it is in Tally: type its number in Add invoice number on the row and press Save.
3. If it is not in Tally: press Retry.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
The note on the row says "we cannot tell whether the billing tool took it. It is not sent
again on its own — a second send would risk a second invoice for one payment."
After Save, it reads "Recorded against … — it moves to Invoice created, marked By
hand." (The page is now called Invoiced, and the chip there reads Manual.)
Gleuhr Guide — Accounts (draft)

"the billing tool already received this request (…) — a retry would book a second
invoice; nothing to retry". Look in Tally and record the number instead.
Who to ask: —

[Screenshot to add: To invoice › Failed, a No answer row with the invoice-number field]
B6. How do I record a Tally invoice number by hand?
When you need this: you made or found the invoice in Tally yourself.
Steps:
1 . Find the row (on Failed, Waiting or Manual invoices).
2. Click in Add invoice number and type the Tally number exactly.
3. Press Save inside the field (or Enter). Escape clears it.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Invoice … already exists for this payment. Recording it again would put one number on
two sales." Check the number.
"the request is still being delivered — wait for the billing tool's answer before recording
a number by hand"
"an invoice request already stands for this collection (CI-…) — …". This payment was
sent. Use the Failed tab, not Manual invoices.
Who to ask: —
Search words: record number, invoice number, Tally number, manual number, by hand,
number daalna.
[Screenshot to add: invoice-number field with Save showing]
How do I…? · Invoicing: held, mapped and reversed
B7. How do I bill a payment on Manual invoices?
When you need this: Manual invoices has a badge. These payments are collected but the
automation can never bill them.
Steps:
1 . Open Manual invoices. Click a row to read why it is held (the panel's note and its fix).
2. Make the invoice in Tally.
3. Type its number into Add invoice number on the row and press Save.
Gleuhr Guide — Accounts (draft)
Page 13 of 41

blocks.title: Page 14
blocks.text:
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the held reasons you will meet, with their fixes:
"No registered billing name": "Raise the bill in Tally against the clinic's own name, then
record the number here."
"Held by the billing rules": the server's own sentence, for example "a payment in this
collection was reversed — nothing to invoice until it is reconciled" or "the collection is
₹ … and the billing tool takes whole rupees — settle the paise first".
Who to ask: the Accounts head if a reason makes no sense.
Search words: manual invoice, held, manual bill, can't invoice, old sale, legacy, hand bill.
Screenshot: [Screenshot to add: Manual invoices]
B8. How do I read the payment panel before sending?
When you need this: you want to see exactly what will go to Tally.
Steps:
1 . Click any row. The panel slides in from the right.
2. Read, top to bottom: how it was paid (Cash / UPI / POS, with RRN, Auth and Txn ID);
Billing details (Billed to, Billed by, Payment received in); Lines that will go to Tally (Line
item · HSN / SAC · Tax · Rate · Qty · Disc · Amount, then Invoice total); and the Trail.
3. The row's own button is at the bottom of the panel.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Missing" in red means a line has no HSN code or tax rate. It will not send (B10).
" ₹ … collected on a ₹ … sale — …% … this sale needs checking before anything else is
invoiced against it." Tell the clinic's BM before you send anything more on that sale.
Who to ask: the BM of the clinic for an over-collected sale.
Search words: panel, drawer, lines, HSN, tax, details, what goes to Tally, invoice preview.
Screenshot:

B9. The row says no Tally name is mapped for a treatment. How do I ﬁx it?
When you need this: the red line reads "no Tally name is mapped for … — map it on the
Sales-Head Tally page before this invoice can be sent …".
Steps:
1 . Open Tally mapping (under Configuration).
2. Press Only not mapped to see the gaps.
3. Fill Name sent to Tally, HSN / SAC (4 to 8 digits) and Tax %, then press Save.
4. Go back to To invoice and send the payment.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"the HSN/SAC must be 4 to 8 digits — got …"
"the tax percent must be between 0 and 28 — got …"
"the tax percent is required — a missing rate is never read as zero …"
If you do not see Tally mapping in the menu, your login has no clinic accounts desk. Ask
the Sales Head to map it.
Who to ask: the Sales Head.
Gleuhr Guide — Accounts (draft)

B10. A product line is missing its HSN code or tax rate. What do I do?
When you need this: the hold reads "the product catalogue is missing a tax fact: …".
Steps:
1 . Do not bill it by hand unless you must. Ask for the product to be fixed.
2. Once the product carries both, the payment moves back to To invoice › Pending by
itself.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "a product invoice is never sent without an HSN code
and a tax rate. Once the product carries both, this payment moves back to Pending for
invoice by itself".
Who to ask: an admin. A product's HSN and GST % are edited on the Admin panel's
Products page.
Search words: product HSN, product tax, missing tax, catalogue, product not mapped,
cream invoice.
[Screenshot to add: payment panel, product line with "Missing" in the HSN column]
B11. How do I record a credit note for a payment reversed after invoicing?
When you need this: Reversed has a badge.
Steps:
1 . Open Reversed. The To do tab is open.
2. Make the credit note in Tally against the invoice shown.
3. Press Record credit note no., type the Tally credit note number, then press Save.

You pass two parts, and each must pass on its own. A good score on one never makes up

What each rating means (approved by the founder, 27 Oct):

1: you could not do it yet.

The people you deal with: clear and polite, and handed off to the right colleague.
Pace: done at normal desk speed.
Ratings are not averaged. For example, 5, 5, 4, 3, 5 is "not yet": you repeat only the task
rated 3. No single mistake fails a task on its own; a mistake lowers that task's rating.
Every attempt and every rating is kept. You are In training until every lesson is passed
AND every task is rated 4 or 5. Then you are Trained. Nothing on your desk is blocked
while you are In training.
How it works: read each lesson and its cards, then answer its 3 questions. The pass mark
is 80% per lesson, so with 3 questions you need 3 of 3. If you fail, re-read the cards and try
again. Every attempt is kept.
Lesson 1 — What the accounts desk is for
The desk checks remote money, invoices every payment, gives receipts, matches the
bank and closes the books. It records what arrived and never edits a sale. Read:
Responsibilities, Rules 8 and 15, E4.
Q1. A collected amount is wrong. Who fixes it?
a) Accounts edits it on the payment panel · b) Reception files an amendment, and the
BM verifies it ✓  · c) The counsellor deletes the payment
Why: the money book is append-only, and accounts never edits a sale.
Q2. Where is an online order invoiced?
a) On To invoice, like a clinic sale · b) In the online CRM ✓  · c) On Manual invoices
Why: anything created there is invoiced there. Clinic pickup and Rapido are read-only here.
Q3. Which page does the desk open on?
a) Verification · b) Bank reconciliation · c) To invoice ✓
Why: the founder chose it, and there is no Today page on this desk.
Lesson 2 — Verifying a remote instalment
Check the proof against the bank, type the amount you see, and press Verified. Read: A1,
A2, A6.
Q1. When can you press Verified?
a) When the screenshot looks fine · b) When the amount you typed from the proof and
bank equals the amount claimed ✓  · c) When the counsellor confirms on the phone
Why: typing the amount is the whole check.

Q2. What must you add before pressing Not verified?
a) Nothing · b) A note saying why ✓  · c) The Accounts head's approval
Why: the counsellor or agent acts on your note.
Q3. A patient paid an instalment by payment link. Where do you verify it?
a) Verification · b) Decided claims · c) Nowhere — the gateway confirms link money by
itself ✓
Why: only money the CRM cannot confirm needs a person.
Lesson 3 — The checks that protect money
No self-verification, one reference once, and shared transfers. Read: A3, A4, A5.
Q1. You recorded a claim yourself. Can you verify it?
a) Yes, if the amount matches · b) No — someone else on the accounts desk must ✓  · c)
Yes, with a note
Why: one person never both records and approves the same money.
Q2. Two claims carry the same UTR because one transfer paid for two patients. What do
you do?
a) Verify the first, reject the second · b) Tick "This one transfer paid for more than one
patient", type the bank total, name the others ✓  · c) Verify both normally
Why: a reference verifies once, unless it is declared as one shared transfer with one bank
total.
Q3. The server says the reference is already verified on another claim, and it was not a
shared transfer. What now?
a) Retry until it goes through · b) Mark this claim Not verified, saying it is a repeat ✓  · c)
Change the reference and verify
Why: the same screenshot must never pay twice.
Lesson 4 — Sending for invoicing
One invoice per payment. Send from Pending. Read: B1, B2, B8.
Q1. A package is paid in three instalments. How many invoices?
a) One, at the end · b) Three, one per payment ✓  · c) One per treatment
Why: the invoice follows the money that actually landed.
Q2. Most entries on Invoiced say "Sent to Tally" with no number. Is something wrong?

a) Yes, record a number on each · b) No — Tally usually does not send a number back, and
the invoice is made ✓  · c) Yes, retry them
Why: a request Tally took is billed. A number is a bonus.
Q3. The payment panel shows "Missing" in the HSN column. What happens if you send?
a) It goes with no HSN · b) It will not send. The product must carry an HSN and a tax rate
first ✓  · c) Tally fills it in
Why: a product invoice is never sent without an HSN code and a tax rate.
Lesson 5 — Refused and No answer
Refused is safe to retry once fixed. No answer: check Tally first. Read: B4, B5, B6.
Q1. A request reads No answer. What is your first step?
a) Press Retry · b) Look for the invoice in Tally ✓  · c) Move it to Manual invoices
Why: it may already exist, and a retry could make a duplicate.
Q2. The invoice is in Tally. What do you do?
a) Retry · b) Type its number into Add invoice number and Save ✓  · c) Nothing
Why: recording the number closes it without a second invoice.
Q3. A request was Refused. When is Retry safe?
a) Never · b) Once what Tally objected to is fixed ✓  · c) Immediately
Why: Tally said it made nothing.
Lesson 6 — Consultations, manual invoices and credit notes
Consultations from 20 Oct are one invoice per visit. Held payments are billed by hand.
Reversed invoices get a credit note. Read: B3, B7, B9, B11.
Q1. A patient paid the consultation fee ₹ 500 by card and ₹ 500 by UPI on 22 Oct. How
many invoices?
a) Two · b) One, for the whole fee ✓  · c) None
Why: from 20 Oct a consultation is invoiced once for its visit, however it was paid.
Q2. A payment was reversed after its invoice went to Tally. What do you record?
a) A new invoice · b) The Tally credit note number, on Reversed ✓  · c) Nothing
Why: the invoice still stands in Tally, so a credit note cancels it.
Q3. Can you change a credit note number once saved?

Lesson 7 — Receipts
Mark as created gives the clinic receipt number once. WhatsApp receipts can be resent
only when Failed. Read: C1, C2, C3.
Q1. Can "Mark as created" be undone?
a) Yes · b) No — it happens once ✓  · c) Only by the Accounts head
Why: a receipt number is a promise in the books.
Q2. A WhatsApp receipt is Unconfirmed. Can you send it again?
a) Yes · b) No — only a Failed one is sent again ✓  · c) After one hour
Why: a second copy of a receipt that did arrive is worse than none.
Q3. WhatsApp refused the number. Who fixes it?
a) Accounts types the new number · b) Reception or the counsellor files it, and a BM
approves it ✓  · c) The patient
Why: the desk cannot change a patient's number.
Lesson 8 — Bank reconciliation: upload and match
Upload yesterday's statements and processor files. Then confirm, link, mark Suspense or
mark Not ours. Read: D1, D2, D3, D7.
Q1. When do bank statements usually come in?
a) 9:00–10:00 · b) 11:30–12:30 ✓  · c) After 18:00
Why: the day page says so.
Q2. A credit has no CRM payment and you cannot find the payer. What do you choose?
a) Not ours · b) Suspense ✓  · c) Leave it open for a week
Why: Suspense lets the receipt go, and you can mark it covered when the payer is found.
Q3. Does matching a credit change the sale?
a) Yes, it fixes the amount · b) No — a match never edits the sale ✓  · c) Only for card
payments
Why: accounts records what arrived.

Lesson 9 — Bulk settlements, Tally and the lock
A group receipt is sent after review. Nothing goes to Tally before the lock, and a locked
day is closed. Read: D4, D5, D8, D9.
Q1. When does a receipt actually go to Tally?
a) The moment you press Confirm · b) After the day is locked ✓  · c) At midnight
Why: a day is checked as a whole before any of it reaches the books.
Q2. A receipt shows No success code. What do you do before withdrawing it?
a) Nothing · b) Check Tally — it may already be there ✓  · c) Retry three times
Why: it is never resent by itself, and withdrawing a receipt that exists makes a gap.
Q3. A file has entries for a locked day. What happens?
a) They are filed anyway · b) They are not filed — tell the Accounts head ✓  · c) The day
unlocks
Why: nothing on a locked day can change.
Lesson 10 — Tokens, Reconciliation and Tally mapping
Tokens shows money on file. Reconciliation is your bank tick. Tally mapping names what
goes to Tally. Read: E1, E2, E3, B9.
Q1. What does an "A-" token mean?
a) Accounts made it · b) The appointment agent took it by payment link before the visit
✓  · c) An adjusted token
Why: T- is the counsellor's chair token, and A- is the agent's.
Q2. What does Mark received on Reconciliation mean?
a) The patient got the receipt · b) You checked the invoice's money against the bank ✓  ·
c) Tally confirmed it
Why: there is no statement import on that page. It is your tick.
Q3. A treatment's invoices refuse with "no Tally name is mapped". Who can fix it?
a) Only an admin · b) The Sales Head, or the clinic accounts desk on Tally mapping ✓  · c)
The counsellor
Why: both desks edit the same Tally mapping page.

Ready for sign-off: what your sign-off lead will ask you to show
On the real desk, with your sign-off lead watching. Each task is rated 1 to 5, and each
needs a 4 or 5.
1 . Verify a remote instalment correctly, and mark one Not verified with a proper note.
What a 5 looks like: checks the UTR and the amount against the bank before typing
anything; types the amount from the proof, not from the claim; the Not verified note
says what was checked and why it failed; never touches a claim they recorded
themselves.
2. Send three payments for invoicing, including one consultation. Explain what "Sent to
Tally" means.
What a 5 looks like: opens the panel and reads the lines before sending; finds the
consultation with the Consultations filter; presses Send for invoicing once per
payment; says "Sent to Tally" means it is billed even with no number back.
3. Handle one No answer: check Tally, then record the number or retry.
What a 5 looks like: does not press Retry first; looks for the invoice in Tally; records the
exact number if it is there, or retries only if it is not.
4. Upload yesterday's statements, decide one "No CRM payment" credit and lock the
day.
What a 5 looks like: each file goes in its own slot with no refused upload left unread;
searches for the CRM payment before choosing Suspense or Not ours; locks only when
the top row shows no open credits and no missing files.
5. Mark a receipt created, and find one token's full story on Tokens.
What a 5 looks like: finds the right payment with search or filters before pressing Mark
as created (it cannot be undone); on Tokens, finds the token, opens its panel and reads
out what is left and where it was used.
